name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery bulk ordering, artwork review, and WooCommerce My Account experience.
changelog:
1.2.4

  • Rebuilds the desktop/tablet My Account shell as exactly two sibling containers: one continuous navy account sidebar and one WooCommerce content area.
  • Fixes Dashboard, Account Details, and individual order pages being nested into or squeezed to the sidebar width.
  • Replaces the four rectangular Dashboard shortcut blocks with an unboxed editorial quick-access band.
  • Keeps the approved mobile Account menu unchanged and preserves Artwork attention indicators plus the All Star navy/gold/cream design system.
  • No Supplier Sync pricing, ASBO tiers, cart, shipping, checkout, artwork storage/review, authentication, or order-security behavior changed.
